From: Coupa Vendor Support <vendor-support@coupa.com>

Subject: RE: Vendor portal activation - Tax ID validation / CS-47382

Hi Laura / Sienna,

Thanks for the details — we've triaged ticket CS-47382. The validation error typically indicates an API-level normalization mismatch between how the supplier submitted the Tax ID and how your buyer's Coupa instance expects it. Two quick paths: 

1) Buyer-side create: Procurement at Orion (buyer) can create the supplier master record in the Coupa admin console and send an invitation that bypasses the public registration form. This is usually fastest.

2) Formatting + lookup: If supplier resubmits, ensure Tax ID is entered as digits only (no dashes/spaces). Some buyer instances also perform a registry lookup that will reject unverified or recently-changed IDs — in those cases buyer-side admin needs to approve.

We can keep CS-47382 open and perform a debug trace if needed. If you want us to perform a forced invite, we need an owner-side task (Procurement admin at Orion) to confirm.

Best,

Coupa Vendor Support
vendor-support@coupa.com
https://support.coupa.com/cs/CS-47382
